_doc: Editorial vocabulary for every string a researcher can read (CLAUDE.md § Code Style → Language, 'Editorial control').
Read by frontend/src/ui/editorialGuard.test.js (the SPA) and tests/test_editorial_guard.py (the webapi's pt-BR strings).
Each pattern is matched case-insensitively as a WHOLE WORD (letters, digits and _ are word characters, accents included),
so 'top' does not match 'Topázio' and 'gold' does not match 'gold_pevs_production'. Patterns must be valid in BOTH
JavaScript (flag u) and Python re: plain alternations, ?, character classes — no lookbehind, no named groups.
To accept a violation, add it to the sweep's PERMITIDOS with a reason; to change the rule, change this file.

italic.rule: A foreign concept kept for lack of a native word is set in italics in LONG text (a sentence), never in a label. In JSX prose write <em>; in a registry string write *termo*, rendered by window.comItalico. Consolidated UI words (link, login, download, e-mail, zoom, beta, API) and the three kept by decision (feedback, status, ranking) are NOT italicized.
